notes.title: Pre-Alpha (Gamescom) Demo now playable for a limited time!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44459252/7a756f4826f7e094e10d631e40daa677898097b8.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]

Last week I had the honor of presenting Journey Beyond the Edge of the World at Indie Arena Booth / Gamescom. It was a wonderful (and exhausting!) experience. While initially planning to only have this demo up on Steam through Gamescom, I've decided to keep it up for a while, most likely for the next two weeks. I've also fixed a couple of bugs and glitches that came up during playtesting. I won't be fixing [i]all[/i] glitches, as I'm currently in the process of rewriting most of the game's systems anyways. But some had to be adressed. See the change log below.

Thank you for playing!

[u]Changelog 0.2.26[/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed FMOD "muffle sound" parameter not being reset after ingame restart
[*] Fixed “that” IK glitch when holding the note
[*] Fixed rope occasionally glitching through hatch
[*] Fixed IK glitch that made hands appear broken on stairs 
[*] Player can now squeeze between broken mast and Trawl winch in chapter one
[/list]
